summary.text: Donna Barnes is a Democratic member of the Missouri House of Representatives who has represented District 28 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Republican Steven Hinton is also on the general election ballot.

paragraphs.text: Donna Barnes graduated from Southeast High School and attended the University of Missouri-Kansas City and Penn Valley Community College.
Her career experience includes 35 years in the Kansas City area as a lead sales service associate for the United States Postal Service.
Barnes was assigned to the House Local Government Committee for 2025-2026.
